summary.text: Timothy Wilkinson is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 73 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Josh Bonner (R).
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a letter carrier with the U.S. Postal Service for 33 years.

paragraphs.text: Timothy Wilkinson earned a high school diploma from St. Joseph High School, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born, raised and educated in the Deep South and has lived in Georgia since 1997.
He wrote that he served as a union representative for many of his 33 years as a letter carrier.
Describing himself as a fiscal conservative and social progressive, Wilkinson wrote that he wants to represent working families in the 73rd District.
